_A_COLOR_PICKER_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTIO:
Accessibility: the field is a button with aria-haspopup="dialog", its name contains the label and the current value. The dialog has role="dialog", the focus stays inside and goes back to the field after closing.

  • Enter, Space, Arrow down: open the dialog.
  • Saturation and brightness area: Arrow left/right saturation, Arrow up/down brightness, Shift + arrow: steps of 10, Home / End, Page up / Page down.
  • Hue and opacity: arrows, Shift + arrow, Home / End.
  • Text field: Enter applies the typed value.
  • Escape closes the dialog without changes.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The AColorPicker component selects a color in a dialog: saturation and brightness area, hue and opacity sliders, a text field for any color format and predefined colors. The field looks like an input that is filled with the selected color; the text color is chosen automatically for the best contrast. The model is changed only with OK. In AForm the component is used with type: "colorPicker"; type: "color" stays the native <input type="color">.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_EVENTS_CLOSE_DESCRIPTION: Emitted when the dialog is closed.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_EVENTS_OPEN_DESCRIPTION_: Emitted when the dialog is opened.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_EXAMPLE_HELP_TEXT_: Choose a color with enough contrast
_A_COLOR_PICKER_GROUP_COLOR_FORMAT_DESCR: color-formats is a format or an array of formats: hex, rgb, hsl, hsv. With several formats the dialog has a switch next to the text field that changes the format in the given order. When the dialog opens, the format of the current value is used if it is in the list, otherwise the first format. The model is written in the chosen format.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_GROUP_DISABLED_DESCRIPTI: disabled disables the field, readonly shows the value with a color swatch.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_GROUP_ERRORS_DESCRIPTION: errors shows the error text and sets aria-invalid, error-icon adds an icon.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_GROUP_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: In AForm and AGroup the component is used with type: "colorPicker". type: "color" renders the native browser color input.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_GROUP_HELP_TEXT_DESCRIPT: help-text and label-description are connected to the field with aria-describedby.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_GROUP_PREDEFINE_DESCRIPT: predefine shows a list of colors that can be chosen with one click. Invalid values are ignored.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_GROUP_SHOW_ALPHA_DESCRIP: With show-alpha the dialog shows an opacity slider. Hex values get the alpha channel as #rrggbbaa.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_PROPS_COLOR_FORMATS_DESC: Format or array of formats of the model value (hex, rgb, hsl, hsv). Several formats show a switch in the dialog.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_PROPS_PANEL_DEFAULT_COLO: Color that the dialog shows when the model is empty.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_PROPS_PLACEMENT_DESCRIPT: Position of the dialog relative to the field.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_PROPS_PREDEFINE_DESCRIPT: List of predefined colors in any supported format.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_PROPS_SHOW_ALPHA_DESCRIP: Shows the opacity slider and writes the alpha channel into the model.
_A_COLOR_PICKER_PROPS_TYPE_DESCRIPTION_: Type of the form element. Used by AForm to choose the component.
